name: io.github.tathagat22/plumb-mcp
description: The AI-native design engineering platform, as one MCP server: extract + verify Figma or live-web design-to-code on one semantic design graph, or generate on-brand Figma pages from a prompt.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma personal access token (read-only). Only needed for the REST path — not required when the Plumb plugin is paired in Figma desktop. Create one at figma.com → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens.

environmentVariables.name: PLUMB_SESSION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional label shown in the Plumb Figma plugin when multiple plumb-mcp servers are paired with the same plugin (multi-agent connect). Defaults to the basename of the current working directory.

environmentVariables.name: UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, free. Lets plumb_source / plumb_design resolve on-brief photos from Unsplash for prompt-to-design generation. Falls back to a keyless Picsum provider when unset.

environmentVariables.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, free. Lets plumb_source / plumb_design resolve on-brief photos from Pexels for prompt-to-design generation. Falls back to a keyless Picsum provider when unset.

environmentVariables.name: PIXABAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, free. Lets plumb_source / plumb_design resolve on-brief photos/illustrations from Pixabay for prompt-to-design generation. Falls back to a keyless Picsum provider when unset.
